title: H₂KG Domain Ontology for Hydrogen Electrochemical Systems
description: Domain-specific ontology for hydrogen electrochemical systems, materials, manufacturing, measurements, computational models, scientific characteristics, datasets, quantity values, and provenance. H2KG separates intrinsic scientific classification from contextual workflow use and publishes external semantic alignments separately.
